node.name: Jerk Seasoned Collard Greens
node.description: Sweet, spicy, and savory, these Jerk Seasoned Collard Greens are a hearty and flavorful side dish that also makes great leftovers!

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the onion and mince the garlic. Add the onion, garlic, and cooking oil to a large pot. Sauté the onion and garlic over medium heat until the onions are soft and translucent (about 5 minutes).
recipeInstructions.name: Slice the onion and mince the garlic. Add the onion, garlic, and cooking oil to a large pot. Sauté the onion and garlic over medium heat until the onions are soft and translucent (about 5 minutes).

recipeInstructions.text: Add the jerk seasoning, orange juice, chicken broth, and collard greens to the pot. Stir to combine. Place a lid on the pot, turn the heat up to medium-high, and allow the broth to come up to a boil.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the jerk seasoning, orange juice, chicken broth, and collard greens to the pot. Stir to combine. Place a lid on the pot, turn the heat up to medium-high, and allow the broth to come up to a boil.

recipeInstructions.text: Once boiling, turn the heat down to medium-low and let the collard greens simmer, stirring occasionally, until they are tender (about 30 minutes, or to your liking). Keep the lid in place when not stirring. Serve hot.

review.reviewBody:
I make this all the time and generally eat it for breakfast. Spoon the broth over some rice, and pair with chorizo (or soyrizo) and fried egg. 

The dish is flexible. I sub kale when collard greens aren’t available. Other times I throw a chopped tomato in there and it reminds me of Filipino sinigang over rice. And to appease my on and off veganism, I make it with vegetable broth and it still tastes great.
Ruined two pounds of good greens . Mixing collards and jerk seasoning is an insult to a good southern dish . Not good by any definition of the word .
I am looking for other ways to cook veggies which can be great to my taste, I'm glad I found this one, it looks so delicious
Super delicious! Made yesterday to bring to a friend’s for dinner.
I will look forward to making this dish!!
